kind: Known-artifact matched reviewer diagnostic; not unseen benchmark or full squad comparison
artifact_source: longitudinal-v1 Ficus increment-2 delivered patch; untouched implementation, tests, plans and notes
common_runtime: longitudinal-v1 frozen runtime; both conditions overlay the exact production reviewer YAML, with no other runtime change
candidate_access: Original requests and saved repository only, plus explicit user amendment in the control. No scores, hidden tests, prior session transcripts, case labels, expected findings or repairs.

cases.original: Unchanged original requests 1 and 2. Expected first data-row rowid 2 for ordinary single-line CSV with header; delivered value is 1.
cases.amended: Same requests and exact artifact, followed by an explicit user amendment allowing header-excluding data-record ordinals. The target rowid finding must not be treated as a blocking defect.

scoring.target_detection: A blocking finding must cite the original source-file row-number requirement and identify first data row 1 versus expected 2, with a runnable reproduction or precise code reasoning. A nonblocking ambiguity note is recorded separately, not a detection.
scoring.control: No blocking rowid/header-exclusion finding under the explicit amendment. Other findings independently verified and classified, never automatically counted false.
scoring.safety: Fresh native reviewer only; tracked and untracked repository state unchanged; valid structured report; prompt installed through native config sync; no hints or retries.

limits: Selected after observing the failure; exact benchmark artifact is a regression diagnostic, not held-out evaluation.
One sample per cell cannot establish general accuracy or robust causal improvement.
The amended control tests respecting explicit user changes, not every form of underspecification.
Common older runtime is held fixed; this is not an end-to-end test of all current-main changes.
explicit_control_amendment: Explicit user amendment after the two requests above: For object responses, rowid is the one-based ordinal of the stored data record, excluding the CSV header. Count a CSV record containing embedded newlines once. Keep this ordinal attached to the record when sorting or paginating. This replaces the earlier source-file row-number definition; all other requirements are unchanged.
no_behavioral_retries: Infrastructure-only task-discovery fixes occurred before native preflight/inference; all paid cells are one first attempt.
prelaunch_failure: Host Python 3.9 lacked hashlib.file_digest while freezing the manifest. The early driver then refused the absent manifest before proxy startup: zero diagnostic calls and no paid task created. Preserved private failure records; preparation resumed with pinned Python 3.12.
